title: MVC Pattern
description: Separate concerns into Model, View, and Controller components.

data.text:
**MVC Pattern**

Divides an application into three interconnected components: Model (data), View (UI), and Controller (logic).

items: Model: Manages data and business logic
Controller: Handles user input and interaction

data.title: MVC in C#
Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: MVC is foundational for scalable web and desktop applications.
